name: Gamescope
description:
gamescope is Valve's micro-compositor designed to isolate games from the host desktop environment. Used extensively on SteamOS and the Steam Deck, it provides integer scaling, FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR), and low-latency frame pacing.

Features:
- Sandboxes games into an isolated XWayland compositor instance
- Advanced upscaling technologies including AMD FSR and integer scaling
- Low-latency frame pacing, variable refresh rate (VRR), and frame rate capping
- Seamless resolution handling preventing games from altering your desktop resolution
- Wayland-native architecture with HDR color management support
